policy.private_evidence_policy: PRIVATE_COMMUNICATIONS_ARE_NOT_REPUBLISHED; ONLY NEUTRAL PUBLIC-SAFE STATUS MAY BE PROJECTED
fair_race_rules: All competition work remains subordinate to fabric://8x8/core and may not create a parallel root.
Every material race claim is classified as PAST_PRESERVED, PRESENT_PROVEN, or FUTURE_GATED.
A public receipt is preferred for every public claim; missing public receipts remain visibly marked.
Comparisons use the same declared denominator, environment, measurement method, and evidence standard for 8x8 and others.
Users, revenue, latency, uptime, scores, placement, telemetry, and capability counts are never fabricated.
Competition deadlines never override security, provenance, privacy, rollback, eligibility, or owner authority.
First place or superiority is never claimed without an official result or a frozen reproducible benchmark covering the stated competitor set.
Past evidence and rollback remain preserved; publication never exposes credentials, private topology, private messages, or signing authority.
